mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM school s WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR s.id = #{schoolId}) AND s.status = 'ACTIVE') AS schoolCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student st WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR st.school_id = #{schoolId}) AND st.status = 'ACTIVE') AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher t WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR t.school_id = #{schoolId}) AND t.status = 'ACTIVE') AS teacherCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course c WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR c.school_id = #{schoolId}) AND c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS courseCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_offering o WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR o.school_id = #{schoolId}) AND o.status NOT IN ('CANCELED')) AS offeringCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR e.school_id = #{schoolId}) AND e.status = 'ENROLLED') AS enrollmentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lesson_session ls WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR ls.school_id = #{schoolId})) AS sessionCount, COALESCE(( SELECT ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.status IN ('PRESENT', 'LATE') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 1 ) FROM attendance a WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR a.school_id = #{schoolId}) ), 0) AS attendanceRate

SELECT s.id AS schoolId, s.school_name AS schoolName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM student st WHERE st.school_id = s.id AND st.status = 'ACTIVE') AS studentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM teacher t WHERE t.school_id = s.id AND t.status = 'ACTIVE') AS teacherCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM course_offering o WHERE o.school_id = s.id AND o.status != 'CANCELED') AS offeringCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM enrollment e WHERE e.school_id = s.id AND e.status = 'ENROLLED') AS enrollmentCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.capacity), 0) FROM course_offering o WHERE o.school_id = s.id AND o.status != 'CANCELED') AS capacity FROM school s WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR s.id = #{schoolId}) ORDER BY s.school_name

SELECT c.category, COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS courseCount, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS offeringCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.status = 'ENROLLED' THEN e.id END) AS enrollmentCount FROM course c LEFT JOIN course_offering o ON o.course_id = c.id AND o.status != 'CANCELED' LEFT JOIN enrollment e ON e.offering_id = o.id WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR c.school_id = #{schoolId}) GROUP BY c.category ORDER BY enrollmentCount DESC, c.category

SELECT a.status, COUNT(*) AS count, ROUND( 100.0 * COUNT(*) / NULLIF(SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (), 0), 1 ) AS percentage FROM attendance a WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR a.school_id = #{schoolId}) GROUP BY a.status ORDER BY FIELD(a.status, 'PRESENT', 'LATE', 'LEAVE', 'ABSENT')

SELECT t.id AS teacherId, t.teacher_no AS teacherNo, t.full_name AS teacherName, s.school_name AS schoolName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS offeringCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 END) AS completedSessions, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM( CASE WHEN ls.status = 'COMPLETED' THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(ls.end_time, ls.start_time)) / 3600 ELSE 0 END ), 1), 0) AS completedHours FROM teacher t JOIN school s ON s.id = t.school_id LEFT JOIN course_offering o ON o.teacher_id = t.id LEFT JOIN lesson_session ls ON ls.offering_id = o.id WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR t.school_id = #{schoolId}) GROUP BY t.id, t.teacher_no, t.full_name, s.school_name ORDER BY completedHours DESC, t.full_name

SELECT COUNT(ce.id) AS evaluationCount, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ce.course_rating), 2), 0) AS averageRating, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ce.course_rating), 2), 0) AS averageCourseRating, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(ce.teacher_rating), 2), 0) AS averageTeacherRating, COALESCE(ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ce.course_rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ce.id), 0), 1 ), 0) AS satisfactionRate, COALESCE(ROUND( 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN ce.teacher_rating >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(ce.id), 0), 1 ), 0) AS teacherSatisfactionRate FROM course_evaluation ce WHERE (#{schoolId} IS NULL OR ce.school_id = #{schoolId})
